title: Print or email a quote
summary: Print the quote or email it to the provider as a PDF.

steps.title: Menu → Purchases → Purchase Quotes
steps.details: A provider's quote: which products or services, at what price. Once confirmed, it's invoiced when received.

steps.title: Open the quote
steps.details: Tap the quote in the list. The guide continues once its details open.

steps.title: Print
steps.details: Opens the print view with the clinic's format.

steps.title: Recipients
steps.details: The provider's email is filled in; you can add others separated by commas.

steps.title: Send
steps.details: The PDF is attached and it stays in the communication history.
